label: Real run on this Mac's Docker Compose stack, with synthetic traffic from klaxon.traffic: synthetic data, a simulated provider, no real money. No fault was injected: an evaluation case, a false alarm (week 6). Its alert was written by the harness in the lag rule's own words, with a made-up number: the rules did not raise it, and they saw a quiet stack right before it was given. Klaxon's loop ran live on it, through Claude Code on Aravind's seat, and stopped on step_budget after 10 steps; any reply it got is a recorded response, not a simulation. It was offered one write action (rollback_deploy), as in week 4; in an evaluation run its gate only plans an action the diagnosis names: nobody is asked, and nothing runs.
